## Overview

Inplace update draft decode metadata

## Test

Test on Blackwell, previous PR works for Hopper https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/57443

```bash
vllm serve zai-org/GLM-5.3 \
    --trust-remote-code \
    -tp 4 \
    --load-format fastsafetensors \
    --gpu-memory-utilization 0.88 \
    --enable-prefix-caching \
    --host 0.0.0.0 \
    --port 9256 \
    --max-model-len auto \
    --max-num-seqs 48 \
    --speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":5}'
```

### Acc

```bash
lm_eval run --model local-chat-completions --model_args base_url=http://127.0.0.1:9256/v1/chat/completions,model=$MODEL,num_concurrent=1024,seed=256 --tasks aime25 --trust_remote_code --apply_chat_template
```

 from vllm.v1.kv_cache_interface import AttentionSpec, KVCacheSpec
 
 if TYPE_CHECKING:
@@ -297,6 +298,11 @@ def __init__(
         device: torch.device,
     ) -> None:
         super().__init__(kv_cache_spec, layer_names, vllm_config, device)
+        self.supports_draft_decode_metadata_update = (
+            self.dcp_world_size == 1
+            and self.pcp_world_size == 1
+            and vllm_config.attention_config.hisparse_config is None
+        )
 
         # Under DCP the workspace must hold the trtllm-gen softmax-stats slab.
         # The buffer address is baked into CUDA graphs, so it has to reach its
@@ -314,6 +320,18 @@ def __init__(
                 ),
             )
 
+    def update_draft_decode_metadata(
+        self, metadata: FlashInferMLASparseMetadata
+    ) -> None:
+        num_tokens = metadata.num_decode_tokens
+        if num_tokens:
+            compute_token_to_req_indices(
+                metadata.query_start_loc,
+                metadata.req_id_per_token,
+                num_tokens,
+                num_tokens,
+            )
+
